instruction: A clean studio photograph with a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist white studio, three women pose closely together. On the left, the woman in the lavender shirt (R2) stands in profile, tilting her head back with a calm expression. In the center, the woman in the green blazer (R3) stands facing left, looking toward the camera with a soft smile. On the right, the woman in the blue blazer (R1) hugs the woman in the green blazer (R3) from behind, wrapping her arms around her chest and smiling warmly. Bright, even studio lighting illuminates the subjects against the plain white background.
